task_summary: Harmonize clinical lab data from multiple healthcare systems by cleaning data formats, detecting mixed units via physiological range boundaries, converting to US conventional units, and outputting clean CSV
decomposition_rationale: This task has three distinct concerns: (1) data cleaning/parsing of structural issues like commas, scientific notation, and missing values, (2) domain-specific unit detection and conversion requiring clinical knowledge of analyte ranges and conversion factors, and (3) the orchestration of applying these to the actual dataset. Skills 1 and 2 separate the generic data cleaning from the clinical domain logic.

skills.name: evo-clinical-data-cleaning
skills.description: Utility functions for cleaning raw clinical lab CSV data: handling decimal comma formats, scientific notation normalization, missing value detection, and numeric coercion of mixed-type columns.
skills.responsibility: Parse and clean structural data quality issues (decimal commas, scientific notation, mixed dtypes, missing values) without any domain-specific clinical knowledge. Provides reusable functions for loading, coercing, and preparing numeric data.
dr_sections: 3. Python Pandas Code Patterns for Data Cleaning
3.1 Reading Mixed Formats and Handling Decimal Commas
3.2 Cleaning Scientific Notation and Mixed Dtypes
3.4 Formatting, Dropping NaNs, and Writing Clean CSV
4.4 Pandas Dtype Issues with Mixed Strings

skills.name: evo-clinical-unit-harmonization
skills.description: Domain-specific clinical lab unit detection and conversion module. Contains conversion factor registry, physiological range boundaries for each analyte, and boundary-based auto-detection logic to identify and convert SI units to US conventional units.
skills.responsibility: Define analyte-specific conversion factors, physiological range thresholds for US and SI units, implement boundary-based auto-detection algorithm, and provide per-analyte harmonization functions that convert values outside expected US ranges using appropriate conversion factors.
dr_sections: 1. Complete Reference of US Conventional Units and Conversion Factors
1.1 CKD-Relevant Analytes: Physiological Ranges and Conversion Factors
2. Algorithm and Strategy for Automatic Unit Detection
5. CKD Feature Description Conventions and Abbreviations
